title: Marsha Acker (Elevate Dialogue CEO) on the STATION DC fireside
summary: Acker is CEO and co-founder of Elevate Dialogue and wrote Staying In It. She heard Ari Shapiro in conversation with Eric at STATION DC, and wrote that the idea landing hardest for her is that a company can earn its users' trust and still be profitable.
blockquote: It's been a long time since I've been so moved by a new book and the message behind it!
attribution_title: CEO & Co-Founder, Elevate Dialogue; author of Staying In It
